verdict.rationale: Runpod docs describe exposing web services via a web proxy alongside SSH/JupyterLab/VS Code access (docs-14, docs-45), and Instant Clusters provide fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance private networking for distributed workloads (docs-4, docs-17, docs-37, docs-48, docs-54), covering both port exposure and inter-instance networking. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of port-exposure mechanics and details on private networking between arbitrary (non-cluster) Pods rather than just clustered nodes.
